title: RUNX1-BMP2 promotes vasculogenic mimicry in laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma via activation of the PI3K-AKT signaling pathway.
authors: Zhu, Qingwen; Zhang, Xinyu; Lu, Fei; Miao, Siyu; Zhang, Chunyang; Liu, Zhenzhen; Gao, Zejun; Qi, Meihao; An, Xiaogang; Geng, Panling; Wang, Sufang; Ren, Hongbo; Han, Fugen; Zhang, Ruyue; Zha, DingJun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RUNX1转录因子调控BMP2促进喉鳞癌血管生成拟态，虽涉及TF-DNA结合（ChIP）但核心是肿瘤表型与信号通路，缺乏AI/物理模拟建模方法，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (LSCC) is one of the most common malignant tumors of the head and neck. Vasculogenic mimicry (VM) is crucial for tumor growth and metastasis and refers to the formation of fluid channels by invasive tumor cells rather than endothelial cells. However, the regulatory mechanisms underlying VM during the malignant progression of LSCC remain largely unknown. METHODS: Gene expression and clinical data for LSCC were obtained from the TCGA and Gene GEO (GSE27020) databases. A risk prediction model associated with VM was established using LASSO and Cox regression analyses. Based on their risk scores, patients with LSCC were categorized into high- and low-risk groups. The disparities in immune infiltration, tumor mutational burden (TMB), and functional enrichment between these two groups were examined. The core genes in LSCC were identified using the machine learning (SVM-RFE) and WGCNA algorithms. Subsequently, the involvement of bone morphogenetic protein 2 (BMP2) in VM and metastasis was investigated both in vitro and in vivo. To elucidate the downstream signaling pathways regulated by BMP2, western blotting was performed. Additionally, ChIP experiments were employed to identify the key transcription factors responsible for modulating the expression of BMP2. RESULTS: We established a new precise prognostic model for LSCC related to VM based on three genes: BMP2, EPO, and AGPS. The ROC curves from both TCGA and GSE27020 validation cohorts demonstrated precision survival prediction capabilities, with the nomogram showing some net clinical benefit. Multiple algorithm analyses indicated BMP2 as a potential core gene. Further experiments suggested that BMP2 promotes VM and metastasis in LSCC. The malignant progression of LSCC is promoted by BMP2 via the activation of the PI3K-AKT signaling pathway, with the high expression of BMP2 in LSCC resulting from its transcriptional activation by runt-related transcription factor 1 (RUNX1). CONCLUSION: BMP2 predicts poor prognosis in LSCC, promotes LSCC VM and metastasis through the PI3K-AKT signaling pathway, and is transcriptionally regulated by RUNX1. BMP2 may be a novel, precise, diagnostic, and therapeutic biomarker of LSCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：喉鳞状细胞癌（LSCC）是头颈部最常见的恶性肿瘤之一。血管生成拟态（VM）对肿瘤生长和转移至关重要，指的是侵袭性肿瘤细胞而非内皮细胞形成液体通道的过程。然而，在LSCC恶性进展过程中，VM的调控机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。方法：从TCGA和Gene GEO（GSE27020）数据库获取LSCC的基因表达和临床数据。利用LASSO和Cox回归分析建立了与VM相关的风险预测模型。根据风险评分，将LSCC患者分为高风险组和低风险组。检查了这两组之间在免疫浸润、肿瘤突变负荷（TMB）和功能富集方面的差异。使用机器学习（SVM-RFE）和WGCNA算法识别LSCC中的核心基因。随后，在体外和体内研究了骨形态发生蛋白2（BMP2）在VM和转移中的作用。为阐明BMP2调控的下游信号通路，进行了western blotting实验。此外，采用ChIP实验来识别调控BMP2表达的关键转录因子。结果：我们基于三个基因（BMP2、EPO和AGPS）建立了一个与VM相关的新型精确预后模型，用于LSCC。TCGA和GSE27020验证队列的ROC曲线均显示出精确的生存预测能力，列线图显示出一定的净临床获益。多种算法分析表明BMP2是一个潜在的核心基因。进一步实验提示BMP2促进LSCC中的VM和转移。LSCC的恶性进展由BMP2通过激活PI3K-AKT信号通路促进，而LSCC中BMP2的高表达源于runt相关转录因子1（RUNX1）对其的转录激活。结论：BMP2预测LSCC的不良预后，通过PI3K-AKT信号通路促进LSCC的VM和转移，并受RUNX1的转录调控。BMP2可能成为LSCC的一种新型、精确的诊断和治疗生物标志物。
